name: THINK
source: Lyn Collins, "Think (About It)" (1972): the break in Wikipedia's excerpt, https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/File:Woo!_Yeah!_(Excerpt,_1972_Lyn_Collins-Think_(About_It)).ogg . The recording is under copyright, so the audio stays out of the repo: save that file here as think.ogg (git ignores it), then node tools/make-kit.mjs kits/think. The excerpt repeats one bar (about 113 BPM), so each pad is the take with the least voice on it. KICK is the hard kick with its hat, KICK 2 the softer one with the hat after it. WOO is the shout before each downbeat and YEAH the one mid-bar, with the drums under it.
